verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents bulk imports into database connections and says user data can be moved "into and out of" Auth0 with bulk imports and exports, so the core import/export capability is its own feature. However, the evidence never says imports accept password hashes, and a community user recalls needing a support ticket to get an export that includes password hashes. That means self-serve, lock-in-free hash export is not delivered. Missing for 10: documented password-hash import (supported algorithms), self-serve export including password hashes, and hands-on corroboration of a complete round-trip migration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-import existing users — including password hashes — and export them again, so I am never locked in

citations.quote: Migrate users from an existing database or service to Auth0 using bulk imports for database connections.
